Nora: quick heads-up — onboarding samples are failing for some students using the python SDK in json_mode. Node CLI yields a green lint but python errors on tool.call outputs. Repro steps below.

Nora: ```bash
# node (passes)
npx redwood-sample lint samples/quickstart.json --schema schemas/toolcall_v2.json

# python (fails)
python -m redwood_samplekit lint samples/quickstart.json --schema schemas/toolcall_v2.json --json-mode
```

Luis: paste the validator message?

Nora: ```
ValidationError: path "output.tools": expected object but got [ {"name":"index","value":"1" } ]
  at validator/main.py:121
```

Grace: interesting. Node helper normalizes arrays-of-kv into objects and also coerces numeric strings to numbers for compatibility with a bunch of third-party tools. Python's jsonschema is strict and doesn't coerce.

Luis: do we want to silently coerce in python? I'd prefer an explicit compatibility mode so users opt-in. Silent changes can hide bugs.

Nora: Agreed. Short-term we should patch samplekit fixtures for the workshop and add a one-off normalizer in the quickstart runner so students don't get blocked. Long-term we should add an explicit `--compat-node` flag to the python lint CLI that applies a minimal set of transforms:
- parse JSON-strings when top-level value looks like JSON
- coerce numeric strings to numbers for scalar fields known to be numeric
- convert arrays-of-kv into objects when items are {key,value} pairs
- unwrap single-element arrays into the element when the schema expects an object

Grace: make sure the flag is documented and tested. Also add a cross-sdk test harness that runs Node and Python lint against the same fixtures and compares canonicalized outputs so we don't regress.

Luis: I'll open a PR for the CLI flag and tests. Plan: small opt-in flag first, samplekit hotfix to unblock bootcamps, then land SDK change with tests and docs.

infra-bot: Branch created: pr/9033 by Luis  CI queued  https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/9033

Nora: thanks. Can someone add a short section in the quickstart FAQ: "Why Node and Python lint may differ" listing the heuristics and a note about opting into the compatibility flag? New hires keep tripping over this.

Grace: adding doc stub now (DOC-1420) and will paste a link in the PR. Also: let's avoid expanding the coercions surface — keep it minimal and explicit.

Luis: PR description will include the exact transform matrix and a changelog note. Targeting patch release after tests pass.

Nora: perfect. I'll update the workshop repo with the samplekit normalizer and mark the task done once CI is green.

Grace: :thumbsup:
